ESV.1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.2: “On the first day of the first month you shall erect the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
ESV.3: And you shall put in it the ark of the testimony, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
ESV.4: And you shall bring in the table and arrange it, and you shall bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.
ESV.5: And you shall put the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and set up the screen for the door of the tabernacle.
ESV.6: You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting,
ESV.7: and place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
ESV.8: And you shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen for the gate of the court.
ESV.9: “Then you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and consecrate it and all its furniture, so that it may become holy.
ESV.10: You shall also anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, so that the altar may become most holy.
ESV.11: You shall also anoint the basin and its stand, and consecrate it.
ESV.12: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and shall wash them with water
ESV.13: and put on Aaron the holy garments. And you shall anoint him and consecrate him, that he may serve me as priest.
ESV.14: You shall bring his sons also and put coats on them,
ESV.15: and anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may serve me as priests. And their anointing shall admit them to a perpetual priesthood throughout their generations.”
ESV.16: This Moses did; according to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.
ESV.17: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was erected.
ESV.18: Moses erected the tabernacle. He laid its bases, and set up its frames, and put in its poles, and raised up its pillars.
ESV.19: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent over it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ESV.20: He took the testimony and put it into the ark, and put the poles on the ark and set the mercy seat above on the ark.
ESV.21: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ESV.22: He put the table in the tent of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil,
ESV.23: and arranged the bread on it before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ESV.24: He put the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle,
ESV.25: and set up the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ESV.26: He put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil,
ESV.27: and burned fragrant incense on it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ESV.28: He put in place the screen for the door of the tabernacle.
ESV.29: And he set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ESV.30: He set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing,
ESV.31: with which Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.
ESV.32: When they went into the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.
ESV.33: And he erected the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
ESV.34: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
ESV.35: And Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
ESV.36: Throughout all their journeys, whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the people of Israel would set out.
ESV.37: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out till the day that it was taken up.
ESV.38: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel throughout all their journeys.

NKJV.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
NKJV.2: “On the first day of the first month you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
NKJV.3: You shall put in it the ark of the Testimony, and partition off the ark with the veil.
NKJV.4: You shall bring in the table and arrange the things that are to be set in order on it; and you shall bring in the lampstand and light its lamps.
NKJV.5: You shall also set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the Testimony, and put up the screen for the door of the tabernacle.
NKJV.6: Then you shall set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
NKJV.7: And you shall set the laver between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
NKJV.8: You shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen at the court gate.
NKJV.9: “And you shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it; and you shall hallow it and all its utensils, and it shall be holy.
NKJV.10: You shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar. The altar shall be most holy.
NKJV.11: And you shall anoint the laver and its base, and consecrate it.
NKJV.12: “Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of meeting and wash them with water.
NKJV.13: You shall put the holy garments on Aaron, and anoint him and consecrate him, that he may minister to Me as priest.
NKJV.14: And you shall bring his sons and clothe them with tunics.
NKJV.15: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to Me as priests; for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
NKJV.16: Thus Moses did; according to all that the LORD had commanded him, so he did.
NKJV.17: And it came to pass in the first month of the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was raised up.
NKJV.18: So Moses raised up the tabernacle, fastened its sockets, set up its boards, put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
NKJV.19: And he spread out the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent on top of it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NKJV.20: He took the Testimony and put it into the ark, inserted the poles through the rings of the ark, and put the mercy seat on top of the ark.
NKJV.21: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, hung up the veil of the covering, and partitioned off the ark of the Testimony, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NKJV.22: He put the table in the tabernacle of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil;
NKJV.23: and he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NKJV.24: He put the lampstand in the tabernacle of meeting, across from the table, on the south side of the tabernacle;
NKJV.25: and he lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NKJV.26: He put the gold altar in the tabernacle of meeting in front of the veil;
NKJV.27: and he burned sweet incense on it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NKJV.28: He hung up the screen at the door of the tabernacle.
NKJV.29: And he put the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NKJV.30: He set the laver between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar, and put water there for washing;
NKJV.31: and Moses, Aaron, and his sons would wash their hands and their feet with water from it.
NKJV.32: Whenever they went into the tabernacle of meeting, and when they came near the altar, they washed, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NKJV.33: And he raised up the court all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the screen of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
NKJV.34: Then the cloud covered the tabernacle of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
NKJV.35: And Moses was not able to enter the tabernacle of meeting, because the cloud rested above it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
NKJV.36: Whenever the cloud was taken up from above the tabernacle, the children of Israel would go onward in all their journeys.
NKJV.37: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not journey till the day that it was taken up.
NKJV.38: For the cloud of the LORD was above the tabernacle by day, and fire was over it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'On the first day of the first month you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
NASB.3: 'You shall place the ark of the testimony there, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
NASB.4: 'You shall bring in the table and arrange what belongs on it; and you shall bring in the lampstand and mount its lamps.
NASB.5: 'Moreover, you shall set the gold altar of incense before the ark of the testimony, and set up the veil for the doorway to the tabernacle.
NASB.6: 'You shall set the altar of burnt offering in front of the doorway of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
NASB.7: 'You shall set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it.
NASB.8: 'You shall set up the court all around and hang up the veil for the gateway of the court.
NASB.9: 'Then you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall consecrate it and all its furnishings; and it shall be holy.
NASB.10: 'You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.
NASB.11: 'You shall anoint the laver and its stand, and consecrate it.
NASB.12: 'Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doorway of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
NASB.13: 'You shall put the holy garments on Aaron and anoint him and consecrate him, that he may minister as a priest to Me.
NASB.14: 'You shall bring his sons and put tunics on them;
NASB.15: and you shall anoint them even as you have anointed their father, that they may minister as priests to Me; and their anointing will qualify them for a perpetual priesthood throughout their generations.'
NASB.16: Thus Moses did; according to all that the LORD had commanded him, so he did.
NASB.17: Now in the first month of the second year, on the first [day] of the month, the tabernacle was erected.
NASB.18: Moses erected the tabernacle and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and inserted its bars and erected its pillars.
NASB.19: He spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent on top of it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.20: Then he took the testimony and put [it] into the ark, and attached the poles to the ark, and put the mercy seat on top of the ark.
NASB.21: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up a veil for the screen, and screened off the ark of the testimony, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.22: Then he put the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.
NASB.23: He set the arrangement of bread in order on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.24: Then he placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
NASB.25: He lighted the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.26: Then he placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the veil;
NASB.27: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.28: Then he set up the veil for the doorway of the tabernacle.
NASB.29: He set the altar of burnt offering [before] the doorway of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.30: He placed the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing.
NASB.31: From it Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.
NASB.32: When they entered the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.33: He erected the court all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the veil for the gateway of the court. Thus Moses finished the work.
NASB.34: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
NASB.35: Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
NASB.36: Throughout all their journeys whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the sons of Israel would set out;
NASB.37: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out until the day when it was taken up.
NASB.38: For throughout all their journeys, the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel.

NLT.1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.2: “Set up the Tabernacle on the first day of the new year.
NLT.3: Place the Ark of the Covenant inside, and install the inner curtain to enclose the Ark within the Most Holy Place.
NLT.4: Then bring in the table, and arrange the utensils on it. And bring in the lampstand, and set up the lamps.
NLT.5: “Place the gold incense altar in front of the Ark of the Covenant. Then hang the curtain at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
NLT.6: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the Tabernacle entrance.
NLT.7: Set the washbasin between the Tabernacle and the altar, and fill it with water.
NLT.8: Then set up the courtyard around the outside of the tent, and hang the curtain for the courtyard entrance.
NLT.9: “Take the anointing oil and anoint the Tabernacle and all its furnishings to consecrate them and make them holy.
NLT.10: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and its utensils to consecrate them. Then the altar will become absolutely holy.
NLT.11: Next anoint the washbasin and its stand to consecrate them.
NLT.12: “Present Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the Tabernacle, and wash them with water.
NLT.13: Dress Aaron with the sacred garments and anoint him, consecrating him to serve me as a priest.
NLT.14: Then present his sons and dress them in their tunics.
NLT.15: Anoint them as you did their father, so they may also serve me as priests. With their anointing, Aaron’s descendants are set apart for the priesthood forever, from generation to generation.”
NLT.16: Moses proceeded to do everything just as the LORD had commanded him.
NLT.17: So the Tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.
NLT.18: Moses erected the Tabernacle by setting down its bases, inserting the frames, attaching the crossbars, and setting up the posts.
NLT.19: Then he spread the coverings over the Tabernacle framework and put on the protective layers, just as the LORD had commanded him.
NLT.20: He took the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant and placed them inside the Ark. Then he attached the carrying poles to the Ark, and he set the Ark’s cover — the place of atonement — on top of it.
NLT.21: Then he brought the Ark of the Covenant into the Tabernacle and hung the inner curtain to shield it from view, just as the LORD had commanded him.
NLT.22: Next Moses placed the table in the Tabernacle, along the north side of the Holy Place, just outside the inner curtain.
NLT.23: And he arranged the Bread of the Presence on the table before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
NLT.24: He set the lampstand in the Tabernacle across from the table on the south side of the Holy Place.

AMP.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.2: "On the first day of the first month (Abib) you shall set up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting [of God with you].
AMP.3: You shall place the ark of the Testimony there, and you shall screen off the ark [from the Holy Place of God's Presence] with the veil (partition curtain).
AMP.4: You shall bring in the table [for the bread] and arrange its setting; you shall bring in the lampstand and mount and light its lamps.
AMP.5: You shall set the golden altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony [outside the veil], and put the [hanging] veil at the doorway of the tabernacle.
AMP.6: You shall set the [bronze] altar of burnt offering in front of the doorway of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
AMP.7: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar [of burnt offering], and put water in it.
AMP.8: You shall set up the courtyard [curtains] all around and hang up the screen (curtain) for the gateway of the courtyard.
AMP.9: Then you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and consecrate it and all its furniture; and it shall be holy (declared sacred, separated from secular use).
AMP.10: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.
AMP.11: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and consecrate it.
AMP.12: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doorway of the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
AMP.13: You shall put the holy garments on Aaron and anoint him and consecrate him, that he may serve as a priest to Me.
AMP.14: You shall bring his sons and put tunics on them;
AMP.15: you shall anoint them just as you anointed their father, so that they may serve as priests to Me; and their anointing shall qualify them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations."
AMP.16: Thus Moses did; in accordance with all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.
AMP.17: Now it happened on the first day of the first month (Abib) in the second year [after the exodus from Egypt], that the tabernacle was erected.
AMP.18: Moses erected the tabernacle, laid its sockets, set up its boards, put in its bars and erected its support poles.
AMP.19: He spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent over it, just as the LORD had commanded him.
AMP.20: He took the Testimony [the stones inscribed with the Ten Commandments] and put it into the ark [of the covenant], and placed the poles [through the rings] on the ark, and put the mercy seat on top of the ark.
AMP.21: Moses brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up a veil (partition) for the screen (curtain), and screened off the ark of the Testimony, just as the LORD had commanded him.
AMP.22: Then he put the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.
AMP.23: He set the bread [of the Presence] in order on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
AMP.24: Then he put the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
AMP.25: Moses mounted and lighted the lamps [on the lampstand] before the LORD, just as the LORD commanded him.
AMP.26: He put the golden altar [of incense] in the Tent of Meeting in front of the veil;
AMP.27: he burned fragrant incense [as a symbol of prayer] on it, just as the LORD commanded him.
AMP.28: Then he set up the screen (curtain) at the doorway of the tabernacle.
AMP.29: He set the altar of burnt offering before the doorway of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as the LORD commanded him.
AMP.30: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar [of burnt offering], and put water in it for washing.
AMP.31: Then from it Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.
AMP.32: When they entered the Tent of Meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed, just as the LORD commanded Moses.
AMP.33: And he erected the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung the screen (curtain) at the gateway of the courtyard. So Moses finished the work.
AMP.34: Then the cloud [the Shekinah, God's visible, dwelling presence] covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory and brilliance of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
AMP.35: Moses was not able to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud remained on it, and the glory and brilliance of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
AMP.36: In all their journeys, whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out;
AMP.37: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not journey on until the day when it was taken up.
AMP.38: For throughout all their journeys, the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel.

NET.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses:

NET.8: You are to set up the courtyard around it and put the curtain at the gate of the courtyard.
NET.9: And take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and sanctify it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.
NET.10: Then you are to anoint the altar for the burnt offering with all its utensils; you are to sanctify the altar, and it will be the most holy altar.
NET.11: You must also anoint the large basin and its pedestal, and you are to sanctify it.
NET.12: “You are to bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
NET.13: Then you are to clothe Aaron with the holy garments and anoint him and sanctify him so that he may minister as my priest.
NET.14: You are to bring his sons and clothe them with tunics
NET.15: and anoint them just as you anointed their father, so that they may minister as my priests; their anointing will make them a priesthood that will continue throughout their generations.”
NET.16: This is what Moses did, according to all the LORD had commanded him — so he did.
NET.17: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month, in the second year.
NET.18: When Moses set up the tabernacle and put its bases in place, he set up its frames, attached its bars, and set up its posts.
NET.19: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent over it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NET.20: He took the testimony and put it in the ark, attached the poles to the ark, and then put the atonement lid on the ark.
NET.21: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, hung the protecting curtain, and shielded the ark of the testimony from view, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NET.22: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the curtain.
NET.23: And he set the bread in order on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NET.24: And he put the lampstand in the tent of meeting opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
NET.25: Then he set up the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NET.26: And he put the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the curtain,
NET.27: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NET.28: Then he put the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
NET.29: He also put the altar for the burnt offering by the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NET.30: Then he put the large basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing.
NET.31: Moses and Aaron and his sons would wash their hands and their feet from it.
NET.32: Whenever they entered the tent of meeting, and whenever they approached the altar, they would wash, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NET.33: And he set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and put the curtain at the gate of the courtyard. So Moses finished the work.
NET.34: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
NET.35: Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud settled on it and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
NET.36: But when the cloud was lifted up from the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out on all their journeys;
NET.37: but if the cloud was not lifted up, then they would not journey further until the day it was lifted up.
NET.38: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, but fire would be on it at night, in plain view of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
